name: slidex
description: PDF slide presenter for beamer decks: movies that play, presenter view, laser, magnifier, speaker notes

scripts.sync-viewer: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.rmSync('viewer', {recursive: true, force: true}); fs.cpSync('../viewer', 'viewer', {recursive: true})"
scripts.package:dev: npm run sync-viewer && SLIDEX_DEV=1 node build.js
